meta.title: {app} – paragliding community
meta.description: News, tips, gear market and flight logbook for paragliding pilots in Türkiye, by {club}.

nav.sosLabel: SOS: emergency help and your position

home.heroText: News, tips from instructors, a second-hand gear market and your flight logbook, in one place. Free, by {club}.

tips.title: Ground School
tips.text: Launching, thermalling, XC, weather and SIV, from beginner to advanced.

market.title: Gear market
market.text: New and used wings, harnesses, reserves and instruments.

logbook.title: Flight logbook
logbook.text: Import IGC/GPX files from your vario or app and see your stats.

sites.title: Sites
sites.text: Launch and landing sites with current wind speed, direction and rain.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Incident reports and lessons shared with the community.

trips.title: Paragliding trips
trips.text: Club trips at home and abroad: sites, requirements, prices and guides. Show interest or sign up.

age.text: We need your date of birth to apply our minimum age (14) and to ask a parent or guardian for consent if you are under 18. It is kept private.

legal.privacyAck: I have read the privacy notice.
legal.termsAccept: I accept the terms of use.
legal.updated: These texts have changed since you last accepted them.

consents.title: Your choices
consents.intro: These are optional. Nothing is pre-selected, and you can change your mind at any time on the Privacy page.

guardian.title: Parent or guardian consent
guardian.text: Because you are under 18, a parent or legal guardian has to confirm your account. We'll email them a link. Your account becomes active once they confirm.
guardian.name: Parent or guardian's name
guardian.sent: Email sent to {email}. The link is valid for 7 days.

marketing_notifications.title: Club news and offers

analytics.title: Usage statistics
analytics.text: Pseudonymised statistics and error reports that help us improve the app.

public_profile.title: Public profile
public_profile.text: Show the public parts of your profile to visitors who are not signed in and to search engines.

live_location.title: Live location sharing
live_location.text: Share your live position through a temporary link while you fly.

incident_special_category.title: Health data in incident reports

guardianConfirm.title: Confirm your child's account
guardianConfirm.intro: {guardian}, {name} has asked you to confirm their account on {app}, the paragliding community app of {club}.
guardianConfirm.what: If you confirm, their account becomes active. Their profile stays private by default, they cannot post in the gear market, and adults they do not follow cannot message them. You can ask us to delete the account at any time by writing to {email}.
guardianConfirm.confirm: I am the parent or legal guardian and I give my consent
guardianConfirm.confirmed: Thank you. The account is now active.
guardianConfirm.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.

profile.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP. We shrink it and remove location data before upload.
profile.licenceHelp: Optional. Only you can see it; it is stored encrypted.
profile.minorNote: Because you are under 18, your profile is private by default.
profile.flyingSinceHelp: The year of your first solo flight.
profile.wingsHelp: Make and model, e.g. Ozone Rush 6 (ML).

profile.totalsHelp: Your totals so far, including flights you did not log here. Flights you import or add can be added on top.

privacy.consentsText: Turn any of these on or off. Changes take effect immediately.
privacy.exportText: A JSON file with everything we store about you. Flight files will be added when the logbook launches.
privacy.requestText: Object to processing, ask for a correction or anything else. We answer within 30 days.
privacy.deleteText: Your profile is anonymised immediately and you are signed out everywhere. After 30 days your account and all its data are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleted: Your account has been deleted. It will be permanently removed after 30 days.

maps.remember: Always show maps on this device

logbook.title: Logbook
logbook.lead: Your flights, records and equipment in one place.
logbook.empty: No flights yet. Import IGC or GPX files from your instrument or phone app, or add a flight by hand.
logbook.manualLead: For flights without a track file. Times are Türkiye time.
logbook.minorPrivate: Accounts under 18 can only share flights with members or keep them private.
logbook.trimNote: Public and members-only tracks hide the first and last 500 m, so nobody sees exactly where you start or land.

fields.gliderHelp: Used when no wing is chosen.

import.title: Import flights
import.lead: Choose one or many IGC or GPX files. We work out takeoff, landing and your stats on the server.
import.help: Up to 8 MB per file. You can select many files at once.
import.privacy: The original file is stored privately so you can download it again. Other people only ever see the track without its first and last 500 m.

errors.unsupported: This is not an IGC or GPX file we can read.
errors.noFlight: No flight found in this file (too few points or no movement).
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

logbook.addToTotals: Add this flight to my total hours and flights

flight.noTrack: No track to show for this flight.
flight.chartLabel: Altitude over time. Use the arrow keys to move along the flight.
flight.trimmedNote: The first and last 500 m are hidden.
flight.shareNotPublic: Only public flights can be shared with a link. Change who can see it under Edit.
flight.downloadFull: Your full track. IGC gives your original file when you imported one.
flight.downloadTrimmed: Without the first and last 500 m.
flight.deleteConfirm: Delete this flight and its file for good?

replay.togetherHelp: Other flights from this takeoff on the same day. Tick one to fly it on the same clock.
replay.loadFailed: That flight could not be loaded.
replay.terrainCredit: 3D terrain: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data (Mapzen).

xc.title: Cross-country score
xc.estimate: An estimate using XContest-style rules (free distance ×1, flat triangle ×1.2, FAI triangle ×1.4, triangles closed within 20%). XContest gives the official score.
xc.dashedNote: The dashed line on the map shows the scored route.
xc.submit: To enter it in XContest, download the IGC above (it is your original file) and upload it on
xc.noOriginal: XContest needs your original IGC file from the instrument; this flight was imported from GPX or added by hand.

equipment.reminderNote: Reminders appear here and, if you turned them on, as push notifications.

safety.title: Safety
safety.lead: Report incidents and near misses, read the lessons, and find emergency help.
safety.sent: Thank you. Your report has reached the safety officers.
safety.justCulture: We follow a just culture: reports are for learning, never for blame. Near misses are just as valuable as accidents.
safety.anonymousNotListed: Fully anonymous reports are not linked to you, so they are not listed here.
safety.statsNote: Counts only. No sites, dates or people are shown.
safety.lessonNote: This lesson is written so that nobody can be recognised. It is not linked to any report.

report.title: Report an incident
report.lead: It takes a few minutes. Only the safety officers read reports.
report.emergency: Is someone hurt right now? Call 112 first.
report.who: How do you want to report?

anonymityHelp.named: Safety officers see your name. Lessons never name anyone.
anonymityHelp.community_anonymous: Safety officers see who you are, so they can ask follow-up questions. Nobody else ever does.
anonymityHelp.fully_anonymous: Your account is not stored with the report, not even for safety officers. Nobody can contact you about it.

report.descriptionHelp: At least 20 characters. Describe the sequence of events.
report.equipmentHelp: Wing, harness, reserve: model and class are enough.
report.lessonsHelp: Your own take helps other pilots most.
report.noNames: Please do not name other people in the report.
report.injuryIntro: Injury details are health data. They are encrypted, only safety officers can read them, every view is logged, and they are deleted one year after the report is closed.
report.injuryConsent: I agree that these health details are processed for flight safety analysis (explicit consent, KVKK Art. 6).
report.consentNeeded: Without your consent we cannot store injury details. You can still send the report without them.
report.injuryDetailsHelp: Only what helps safety: e.g. "sprained ankle on landing".
report.contactOk: A safety officer may contact me about this report
report.encryptionMissing: Injury details cannot be stored right now. Please send the report without them.

events.lead: Club trips, courses, competitions and get-togethers.
events.closed: Sign-ups for this event are closed.

rides.intro: Share a car to the launch or find a retrieve driver. Only adult members see this board, and posts are deleted 30 days after the ride.
rides.fromHelp: A district or meeting point, not your home address.
rides.privacyNote: Other adult members will see this post with your name. Agree on details in a private message.
rides.empty: No rides yet. Post the first one!
rides.adultsOnly: The ride board is only for adult members.

groups.membersHelp: You can add people you follow.
groups.followFirst: Follow a few pilots first, then you can add them to a group.
groups.adultsOnly: Group chats are only for adult members.
groups.memberNotAllowed: Someone you picked cannot join group chats (they may be under 18, inactive or blocked).
groups.creator: created the group

sos.title: Emergency
sos.lead: Call for help and tell them exactly where you are.
sos.positionHelp: Your browser will ask for permission. The position stays on your phone.
sos.positionError: Your position could not be found. Check that location is on and allowed for this site.

tell.what: What happened (e.g. paraglider accident, tree landing).
tell.where: Where: read out the coordinates above.
tell.injuries: Injuries and whether the person is conscious and breathing.
tell.callback: Your phone number, and keep the line free.

tips.tree: In a tree: stay clipped in and wait for rescuers. Do not climb down on your own.
tips.water: In water: get out of the harness and away from the lines as fast as you can.
tips.wing: Spread the wing out on open ground: it is easy to see from the air.
tips.battery: Save your phone battery: close other apps and lower the screen brightness.
tips.helicopter: For a helicopter, secure the wing so the downwash cannot lift it.

sos.privacy: This page works without an account and sends nothing to our server.

offline.saved: Pages you visited recently (news, tips, sites, events, safety) are saved for offline reading when you are signed out.
